faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: A hackathon is an event where people engage in rapid and collaborative engineering to solve a problem.
faq.a2: Yes, the theme for this hackathon is "How to use technology, not used by technology."
faq.a3: Projects will be judged on how well AI is utilized, innovation and creativity, and how effectively does it solve the problem. Check the judging rubic for more specific metrics :)
faq.a4: Yes, there will be several more hackathons that follow :D
faq.q5: How will I receive info during the hackathon?
faq.a5: You will be informed through the organizing teacher of your school and through updates on our mini program.
